_README.title: Housing & Affordability Dashboard
_README.description: Housing activity, home prices, financing costs, and household affordability metrics from FRED.
_README.purpose: Summarize housing supply/demand health and borrower cost pressure for macro monitoring and market commentary.

HOUST.description: New privately-owned housing units started (construction pipeline).
HOUST.interpretation: Higher starts signal growing supply; sustained drops can flag builder pullback.

PERMIT.description: Housing units authorized by permits (leading indicator for future starts).
PERMIT.interpretation: Permits tend to turn before starts; falling permits often precede slower construction.

HSN1F.description: New single-family houses sold (demand for new construction).
HSN1F.interpretation: Rising sales point to healthy builder demand; sharp drops can warn of demand softening.

EXHOSLUSM495S.description: Existing single-family home sales (resale market volume).
EXHOSLUSM495S.interpretation: Higher turnover suggests active resale demand; low volumes can reflect tight inventory or weak demand.

CSUSHPINSA.description: S&P/Case-Shiller U.S. National Home Price Index (broad home price level).
CSUSHPINSA.interpretation: Higher is not always better; fast price gains can worsen affordability while broad declines can signal stress.

MORTGAGE30US.interpretation: Lower rates improve monthly payments and refinance ability; rapid increases pressure affordability.

MORTGAGE15US.interpretation: Tracks shorter-term mortgage pricing; helpful for refinance affordability comparisons.

TDSP.description: Household debt service payments as a percent of disposable personal income.
TDSP.interpretation: Lower ratios indicate more cushion for debt service; rising ratios tighten household cash flow.

MDSP.description: Mortgage debt service payments as a percent of disposable personal income.
MDSP.interpretation: Direct affordability gauge for mortgage payments; rising values reduce affordability.

T10YIE.interpretation: Higher expectations can pressure mortgage rates and real affordability over time.

trading_applications.homebuilders: Pair starts/permits/sales trends with mortgage rates to assess homebuilder earnings sensitivity.
trading_applications.macro_risk: Use debt service ratios and breakeven inflation as affordability stress markers in macro risk dashboards.

notes.grading: Percentile grades use indicator interpretation (higher vs lower is better).
notes.resampling: Series are adaptively resampled to a storage-friendly cadence per frequency before history is saved.
